verdict.rationale: Evidence implies feedback aggregation (docs-7's 'declutter & find impactful opportunities with AI' and docs-4's integrations to pull in feedback from multiple tools) but nothing explicitly describes a unified, searchable repository capturing input from both colleagues and customers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a searchable feedback board/repository, description of internal (colleague) vs external (customer) submission channels, and any search/filter feature details.
